title: Immigration Entry
intro: Route: US → Beijing (China) → Hanoi (Vietnam) → Đà Nẵng → US. Citizenship assumed US. Travel dates September 1–14, 2026. No ETIAS, UK ETA, or EES applies to this route.

tables.caption: China Entry
rows: B-2 Tourist Visa (US citizens require a visa)

tables.caption: Vietnam Entry
rows: E-visa (90 days, single or multiple entry)
3 business days typical; apply at least 7 days before arrival

tables.caption: Passport Validity
rows: Valid until at least March 14, 2027; 3 blank pages total

tables.caption: Application Timeline
rows: Verify passport validity and blank pages (both travelers)
Apply for China B-2 visa (both travelers)
Print/save visa approvals, hotel bookings, flight confirmations

bullets.heading: China Arrival Protocol
items: Customs declaration form required on arrival
Biometric data (fingerprints) collected at first entry
Hotels register foreign nationals with police — confirm at check-in
Download and test VPN before entering China

bullets.heading: Vietnam Domestic Transit
items: Hanoi → Đà Nẵng domestic flight — no additional visa required
Board with same passport + Vietnam e-visa

bullets.heading: Recommended Vaccinations (not required)
items: Hepatitis A
Typhoid
Tetanus
Flu shot (Sept is start of flu season)
Consult travel medicine clinic 6–8 weeks before departure

bullets.heading: Entry Checklist — China
items: China B-2 visa approved (or valid 10-year visa)
Passport valid through March 2027; 2+ blank pages
Hotel confirmation (Beijing) in English and Chinese
Return/onward ticket; customs declaration form
VPN app downloaded and tested before entry

bullets.heading: Entry Checklist — Vietnam
items: E-visa approval letter (print + digital)
Passport valid through March 2027; 1+ blank page
Hotel confirmation (Hanoi + Đà Nẵng)
Onward/return flight confirmation; $25 fee paid online

callouts.text: China visa rules can change quickly — verify at travel.state.gov and Chinese consulate within 30 days of applying
Citizenship assumed US — if incorrect, regenerate this step
Vietnam e-visa straightforward for US citizens — no additional health declarations required as of 2026
Backup: China visa denied → pivot to Japan or South Korea (visa-free); Vietnam e-visa rejected → reapply or visa-on-arrival at major airports
